violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED ON RACKS IN THE KITCHEN: PORK & SEAWEED BUNS AT 58F (3.5HRS) OBSERVED IN AMBIENT SELF-SERVICE DISPLAY: RED BEAN PASTE BUN AT 63F (OVERNIGHT), RED BEAN YOLK BUN AT 64F (OVERNIGHT), TAROT YOLK BUN AT 64F (OVERNIGHT)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: PIC CHOSE TO DISPOSE OF THE PORK AND SEAWEED BUNS. ALL TCS FOODS IN AMBIENT SELF SERVICE DISPLAY CASE LEFT OVERNIGHT WERE DISPOSED OF. PIC AND STAFF WERE RE-EDUCATED ON TCS FOODS.

violations.title: Thermometer, Appropriate for Thin Foods
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a small diameter food temperature measuring device. Pic produced a laser thermometer for the establishment to check food temperatures
violations.corrective_action: A small diameter metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible to accurately measure the temperature of thin foods such as meat patties and fish filets. PIC and EHS reviewed thermometer requirement for the establishment for temperature monitoring of foods

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Hot water valve at the three vat sink is leaking, staff has to turn on and off the water at the wall connection
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PIC agreed to have the three vat sink repaired
